gates.name: Frozen Artifact Integrity Verification
gates.evidence: All 29 CBE-0.7.0 canonical hashes, CBE-0.8.0 model bundle, classifier thresholds, and calibrations C & E verified bit-for-bit.

gates.name: Git History & Ancestry Consistency
gates.evidence: Linear ancestry verified from 0222677 -> 052363e (09.7) -> f8e14cb (09.8). No rebasing or history rewriting.

gates.name: Bootstrap Strategy Feasibility
gates.evidence: Hybrid Snapshot-first (Option C) + single bootstrap fallback (Option B) designed, audited, and tested.

gates.name: Full-Window Warm-Up Safety Contract
gates.evidence: Strict distinction between MINIMUM_COMPUTABLE (72) and FULL_WINDOW_READY (288). Partial-window scoring strictly prohibited.

gates.name: Missing-Data & Zero-Value Quality Safety
gates.evidence: Distinguishes legitimate zero volume z-score from zero-variance and missing-input fallbacks. Fail-closed on all non-pristine inputs.

gates.name: Closed-Candle Causality Enforcement
gates.evidence: Strict closed-candle validation, timestamp monotonic ordering, and out-of-order rejection verified.

gates.name: Timestamp Trust & Clock-Skew Model
gates.evidence: Three-tier timestamping (exchange close, local receipt, durable commit) with monotonic reference and <= 1,000 ms clock-skew budget.

gates.name: Snapshot Recovery & Corruption Detection
gates.evidence: Atomic writes, SHA-256 payload checksums, corruption detection, and truncated-file recovery 100% verified.

gates.name: Candidate C & E Research Isolation
gates.evidence: Dual-branch parity preserved: identical inputs, identical Ridge point forecast, identical market state; separate calibrated intervals.

gates.name: Computational Resource Budget Adherence
gates.evidence: Mean candle ingest latency 0.08 ms << 150 ms; buffer footprint ~38 KB; peak process memory ~45.5 MB << 150 MB.

gates.name: Coolify Deployment Safety Verification
gates.evidence: Autonomous agent cannot query Coolify API console. Remote push is blocked (PUSH_BLOCKED_AUTO_DEPLOY_UNVERIFIED).

gates.name: Production Model Freeze & Isolation
gates.evidence: Sprint 07 freeze verified (29/29). Zero production files, workers, or live databases mutated. Zero live exchange calls.
